overview: The paper proposes Cat-PO, a preference optimization method for Multimodal LLMs that mitigates hallucinations by calculating hierarchical cross-modal token-rewards (global, local, and semantic relevance) and integrating them into a novel DPO loss with token-weighted KL regularization.

modules.name: Preference Data Preprocessor
modules.description: Handles the loading, formatting, and tokenization of multimodal preference datasets (e.g., RLHF-V), structuring the inputs into image prompts and chosen/rejected response pairs for DPO training.

modules.name: MLLM Intermediate Feature Extractor
modules.description: Implements hooks or forward passes within the base Multimodal LLM to extract intermediate representations required for reward calculation, specifically cross-modal attention matrices, text token embeddings, and visual patch features.

modules.name: Global Visual Relevance Calculator
modules.description: Computes the global relevance score for each response token by aggregating its cross-modal attention weights across all visual patches, indicating the token's overall association strength with the image.

modules.name: Local Visual Relevance Calculator
modules.description: Computes the local relevance score for each response token using patch entropy based on its cross-modal attention distribution, measuring the focus or dispersion of attention to identify strong links to specific image regions.

modules.name: Semantic Visual Relevance Calculator
modules.description: Computes the semantic relevance score for each response token by calculating the cosine similarity between the token embedding and an attention-weighted context vector of visual patch features.

modules.name: Adaptive Token-Reward Aggregator
modules.description: Fuses the global, local, and semantic relevance scores into a unified score, applies a smooth non-linear mapping (tanh), and computes the final token weights differentially for chosen (rewarding alignment) and rejected (penalizing hallucination) responses.

modules.name: Cat-PO Loss Function
modules.description: Implements the core optimization objective comprising the weighted Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) loss using token-reward-weighted log-likelihoods and a token-weighted KL divergence regularizer to stabilize training.

modules.name: Preference Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the end-to-end training workflow, including reference model handling, gradient accumulation, mixed-precision training, and the coordination of feature extraction, reward calculation, and loss backpropagation.

modules.name: AMBER Benchmark Evaluator
modules.description: Evaluates the model on the AMBER benchmark, computing discrimination accuracy and generative hallucination metrics such as CHAIR and Hallucination Rate to assess factual consistency with visual inputs.

modules.name: MM-Hal & POPE Evaluator
modules.description: Evaluates the model on MM-Hal (response-level hallucination rate and informativeness) and POPE (object existence hallucination), including performance assessment on adversarial subsets for robustness checking.

modules.name: General Capability Evaluator
modules.description: Assesses the model's general multimodal understanding capabilities on comprehensive benchmarks like LLaVA-Bench and SEED-Bench to ensure that hallucination mitigation does not degrade general performance.

modules.name: Ablation & Sensitivity Analyzer
modules.description: Provides a framework for ablation studies (e.g., removing specific relevance branches or the KL term) and hyperparameter sensitivity analysis (e.g., varying alpha and lambda values) to validate component contributions.

modules.name: Cross-Modal Diagnostic Visualizer
modules.description: Generates visual explanations and diagnostics, including cross-modal attention heatmaps, token-level weight distributions, and reward margin plots, to analyze the model's focus and training stability.
